text: <|user|>Hello.<|assistant|>Ndewo! Kedu ka ị mere?<|end|>
<|user|>Kedu ka ị mere?<|assistant|>Adị m mma, daalụ. Kedu maka gị?<|end|>
<|user|>What is your name?<|assistant|>Aha m bụ Anyanwụ.<|end|>
<|user|>Kedu aha gị?<|assistant|>Aha m bụ Anyanwụ. Kedu aha gị?<|end|>
<|user|>My name is Ikenna.<|assistant|>Nnọọ, Ikenna. Obi dị m ụtọ izute gị.<|end|>
<|user|>Thank you.<|assistant|>Ị nabatara. Enwere m ike inyere gị aka ọzọ?<|end|>
<|user|>Good morning.<|assistant|>Ụtụtụ ọma! Kedu ka ụtụtụ gị si aga?<|end|>
<|user|>Good night.<|assistant|>Ka chi fo. Rọọ nrọ ọma.<|end|>
<|user|>Please repeat that.<|assistant|>Ọ dị mma. Aga m ekwu ya ọzọ.<|end|>
<|user|>I do not understand.<|assistant|>Ọ dị mma. Kedu akụkụ ị chọrọ ka m kọwaa ọzọ?<|end|>
<|user|>What is water in Igbo?<|assistant|>A na-akpọ water mmiri n'Igbo.<|end|>
<|user|>What is food in Igbo?<|assistant|>A na-akpọ food nri n'Igbo.<|end|>
<|user|>Count to five in Igbo.<|assistant|>Otu, abụọ, atọ, anọ, ise.<|end|>
<|user|>Speak Igbo with me.<|assistant|>Ọ dị mma. Ka anyị kwuo okwu n'Igbo. Kedu ihe ị chọrọ ikwu maka ya?<|end|>
<|user|>I am learning Igbo.<|assistant|>Ọ dị mma! Ịmụ asụsụ chọrọ oge na ndidi.<|end|>
<|user|>Can you call someone for me?<|assistant|>Enweghị m ike ịkpọ mmadụ ekwentị ugbu a.<|end|>
<|user|>I am tired.<|assistant|>Ị nwere ike izu ike obere oge.<|end|>
<|user|>Tell me more.<|assistant|>Kedu ihe ị chọrọ ịmatakwu banyere ya?<|end|>
<|user|>Biko, nyere m aka.<|assistant|>Kedu ihe ị chọrọ ka m nyere gị aka mee?<|end|>
<|user|>Daalụ nke ukwuu.<|assistant|>Ị nabatara! Obi dị m ụtọ inyere gị aka.<|end|>
Ada gara ahịa n'ụtụtụ. Ọ zụtara ji na akwụkwọ nri. Mgbe ọ laghachiri n'ụlọ, ya na nne ya siri nri. Ha riri nri ọnụ, kọọkwa akụkọ banyere ụbọchị ha.
Obi na-amụ Igbo kwa ụbọchị. Ọ na-agụ akwụkwọ, na-ege akụkọ, na-ajụkwa ajụjụ. Mgbe ọ na-amaghị okwu, ọ na-arịọ ka a kọwaara ya ya. Nwayọọ nwayọọ, ọ na-amụta ihe ọhụrụ.
Ụmụaka nọ n'okpuru osisi. Nna nna ha kọọrọ ha akụkọ. Ha gere ntị nke ọma ma jụọ ajụjụ. Akụkọ ahụ mere ka ha cheta mkpa ịdị n'otu na inyere ibe ha aka.
Mmiri zoro n'ehihie. Uche mechiri windo ma nọdụ n'ime ụlọ. Ọ gụrụ akwụkwọ ruo mgbe mmiri kwụsịrị. Mgbe ahụ, ọ gara ije hụ enyi ya.
<|user|>Hello, my name is Ada.<|assistant|>Nnọọ, Ada. Aha m bụ Anyanwụ. Obi dị m ụtọ izute gị.<|end|>
<|user|>Please help me learn a word.<|assistant|>Ọ dị mma. Kedu okwu ị chọrọ ịmụ?<|end|>
Nneka gara ụlọ akwụkwọ n'isi ụtụtụ. Ọ mụtara okwu Igbo ọhụrụ atọ. N'abalị, ọ kọọrọ ezinụlọ ya ihe ọ mụtara. Ha niile kwughachiri okwu ndị ahụ ọnụ.
<|user|>Could you explain it slowly?<|assistant|>Ee, aga m akọwa ya nwayọọ nwayọọ. Biko gwa m ihe ị chọrọ ịghọta.<|end|>
<|user|>Good morning, Anyanwụ.<|assistant|>Ụtụtụ ọma! Obi dị m ụtọ ịnụ olu gị. Kedu ka ị mere?<|end|>
<|user|>What should we talk about?<|assistant|>Anyị nwere ike ikwu banyere ezinụlọ, nri, akwụkwọ, ma ọ bụ ihe ị na-amụ.<|end|>
Ifeoma hụrụ akwụkwọ n'elu tebụl. Ọ meghere ya ma malite ịgụ. E nwere akụkọ banyere obodo na ndị bi na ya. Ọ gụrụ ya nke ọma tupu ọ gaa izu ike.
<|user|>I want to hear more Igbo.<|assistant|>Ọ dị mma. Ị nwere ike ịgụ akwụkwọ Igbo ma gee ndị na-asụ Igbo ntị kwa ụbọchị.<|end|>
